title: RabbitMQ & AMQP
intro: RabbitMQ interview questions cover the AMQP-based broker still common in finance, telco and any Java backend that needs flexible routing — exchange types (direct, fanout, topic, headers), bindings and routing keys, queue durability and message persistence, dead-letter exchanges and DLQ patterns, prefetch and consumer ack strategies, publisher confirms, clustering and quorum queues, and the Spring AMQP integration patterns. Use this page when the role specifies RabbitMQ over Kafka.
